name: Acid Arrow
description:
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within long range. On a hit, it takes 4d4 damage immediately and 2d4 damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, it takes half of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn.

Describe the arrow.
successes:
✨: +1d to the initial damage roll.

🌞: Hit or miss, the creature takes 1d4 damage at the end of each of its turns for the next minute.

💀: The acid explodes in your face. You become the target of the spell and the spell automatically hits. Check a Condition.
